observations.seen: Flat ambient fill dominates. Ceiling strip lights emit little visible falloff, apart from a warm floor pool in frame 4 and a soft teal glow in frame 3. Walls in frame 1 are nearly uniform brown and dark green.

There are no contact shadows where walls meet the floor or under the pickups. The only shadowing is a soft gradient on the floor in frame 1 and a darkened recess. The pillar figure in frame 4 has no grounded shadow.
The water plane in frame 2 is an opaque flat cyan slab with no reflection or refraction. The frame 3 pit is a black void. Floors show no specular response.

Corridors are untextured boxes with repeated glowing baseboard strips. The floor decal 'B-3 FORGE HALLS' in frame 4 adds some identity. Otherwise there is little Cold-War bunker dressing: no pipes, signage, crates or props.
Light distance fog darkens the far corridor in frames 2 and 3. There are no visible dust, steam or volumetric shafts. The orange particle puffs in frame 2 are tiny and sparse.
Walls are flat albedo with faint panel seams, and frame 1 shows grainy noise. Ceilings and floors are single-colour planes. Only the pistol viewmodel has detailed PBR-like texturing.
The pistol model in frames 3 and 4 is detailed. In frame 1 the weapon is a blobby yellow placeholder shape. Enemies and props are a distant purple pillar figure and a small crate pickup.
Central one-point perspective corridors are readable, but every frame is the same symmetric hallway with little focal interest. The frame 2 water edge creates a hard horizontal cut.
FOV is reasonable and the viewmodel sits well in frames 3 and 4. In frame 1 the weapon is clipped at the bottom centre and overlaps the HUD panel.
Mild bloom appears on the ceiling lights in frame 3 and the warm glow in frame 4, along with some vignetting. Frame 1 has visible noise or grain artefacts and no tone-mapping cohesion.
Only static frames are available. The muzzle and particle puffs in frame 2 are minimal, and no enemy animation is visible.

The HUD bar is clean and well-typeset with health, armor, ammo, score, kills and time, plus a floor title card and kill feed. However, the controls hint bar and the HUD overlap the weapon in frame 1. Frames 3 and 4 have no HUD at all, which is inconsistent.
